overview: A new TDTR platform under construction. Its intended role is to increase measurement throughput and provide a dedicated line for method development. Final optical configuration and validated ranges will be published after commissioning.
overviewZh: 在建的第三套 TDTR 平台，目标是提升测试通量，并为方法开发提供独立光路。最终光路配置和经验证量程将在调试完成后公布。
principle: A modulated pump-pulse train heats the sample transducer. Scanning the probe delay measures the transient thermoreflectance response, which is fitted with a multilayer heat-flow model. This line is under construction; its validated performance will be established during commissioning.
principleZh: 调制泵浦脉冲序列加热样品表面的金属传感层，扫描探测光延迟以测量瞬态热反射响应，并用多层传热模型拟合。该系统仍在建设中，实际测量性能需经调试与标定确认。
